text: {"lessons":["I should base sell decisions on a stock’s outlook and my plan, not on whether I’m below my average cost; realizing a loss alone doesn’t make a sale wise.","I made repeated purchases of Stock C and Stock D, so I should check my overall exposure and keep enough cash for future needs before adding more.","My account value rose over these periods, but that doesn’t show which trades helped; I should judge decisions by a consistent long-term plan rather than short-term account changes."]}
